scope: Director materialization-quality repair final provider request
symptom: Rejected Director candidates alternated Rust failures between tests/edges.rs and tests/product.rs even though physical rollback was correct.
root_cause: The quality-repair prompt projected verifier source context for current failures and regression guards, but candidate_rejection_errors were rendered as diagnostic strings only. The next Director request therefore lacked the rejected candidate's executable setup, calls, and assertions and could not reliably preserve both behavior surfaces.
required_fix: Project bounded read-only verifier source context for candidate_rejection_errors using the same workspace-scoped extractor as current failures, without expanding Director write authority.
required_tests: Rejected candidate diagnostics include nearby verifier setup/call/assertion source.
Verifier source remains read-only and does not add authorized tool paths.
Existing current-failure and regression-guard source-context tests remain green.
A fresh child backend same-run QA retry exposes the new source block in the final provider request.
prohibited_actions: expand repair write scope to tests
